I found the fix commit: `b2625f9` "Fix write buffer overflow by 1 in domain_to_punycode()". This is the fix for the exact bug. Let me look at this commit to understand the root cause.

The commit message says: "This issue has been triggered after the previous commit increased the size of label_buf. It has been found by OSS-Fuzz (issue 39226)."

Let me look at the diff of this fix commit.
